results.title: The Call
results.overview: Sophia works at an insurance company. Every day, she has to review the outstanding invoices. Today she has to call Jonathan David Brown.

results.title: Ballroom Night
results.overview: A documentary that takes the audience into the world of Ballroom Culture through visual and sound experimentation, along with personal stories from those who are part of this scene.

results.title: Oh Bhama Ayyo Rama
results.overview: A man pursuing life abroad meets a chaotic, free-spirited woman who pulls him back into filmmaking-a passion he abandoned after trauma. Through their love story, he confronts his past wounds and rediscovers his creative soul.

results.title: Right Now
results.overview: Laura and Sami are in love, but both feel pressured by their friends' expectations of what they should experience and accomplish at age 15. During a party in the local park, Laura makes an unexpected move that catches Sami off guard and forces him to choose between deception and honesty.

results.title: Sex in the Soviet Union
results.overview: A gripping journey through seven decades of sexual ignorance, oppression, and suffering, brought to life through the words and experiences of the first Soviet sexologist. Ukrainian survivors of the regime courageously recount the harsh realities they endured, from the pervasive suppression of sexual expression to the rampant exploitation and abuse that plagued Soviet society.

results.title: All Hail the Duck King
results.overview: When Bill struggles with artist’s block, a figure from his past emerges - leading him on a journey to embrace his true self.

results.title: Paying for It
results.overview: In the late 1990s, when Sonny seeks to redefine his long-term relationship with Chester, the painfully introverted cartoonist begins sleeping with sex workers and discovers an unexpected new form of intimacy.

results.title: Butch Cassidy and the Wild Bunch
results.original_title: Butch Cassidy and the Wild Bunch
results.overview: When Butch Cassidy and his deadly band of outlaws pull off a high-dollar train robbery, the legendary Pinkerton detectives raise a deadly posse to hunt them down.

results.title: The Makropulos Case
results.overview: At the heart of Věc Makropulos is a recipe for a life-prolonging elixir invented by the doctor Hieronymus Makropulos for Emperor Rudolf II.  It was tested on the doctor's beautiful daughter, who has now been on earth for 337 years and has had countless affairs over the generations. In the end, however, the seemingly young woman has to realize that an endless life on this side of the world only brings loneliness.

results.title: Nightfall
results.overview: On her birthday, Ann visits the P.O.D. outpost where her estranged gay fathers, Callum and Devin, reunite for her. A scream attracts deadly raptors, forcing the family to take refuge in their car as Ann suffers an asthma attack. When a smuggled raptor egg is revealed, returning it becomes their only chance to survive.

results.title: Mouth Watering
results.overview: The plot follows a couple isolated on a sort of farm. Without internet or television, they prepare a game of seduction, where the main weapon is gastronomy. Cooking for each other, the characters reveal their secrets.

results.title: Film Copacabana
results.overview: A woman places a chair on the sidewalk in Rio and watches as the neighbourhood "unfolds" before her eyes – like a movie scene. Workers, tourists, dogs and street life combine to form a Copacabana portrait, through clever editing and montage.

results.title: Missed Opportunities
results.overview: Missed Opportunities is a powerful faith-based drama starring Dean Cain, Eddie McClintock, and Tim Ross that explores how often we overlook the moments God gives us to believe. Through a moving series of interconnected stories, one man’s spiritual journey reveals how the average person hears the Gospel 76 times before accepting Christ — and how grace keeps calling even when we don’t listen. When he buys a struggling youth camp, his mission becomes clear: to make sure no one misses their opportunity to know Jesus.

results.title: KNOT
results.overview: After thirteen years away, a former enforcer known as KNOT is summoned back to New York by the organization he escaped. What begins as closure turns into a violent reckoning with his past, his loyalty, and a truth he never saw coming.

results.title: You'll Be Fine
results.overview: On the day of Juliana’s son’s wedding, memories haunt her as she tries to come to terms with the recent loss of her husband, accept her son’s impending marriage and step into an unknown future.

results.title: Stardom New Blood 26
results.original_title: プロレスファン必携アプリSTOMPING Presents NEW BLOOD 26
results.overview: New Blood 26 was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on October 30, 2025, at Kanda Myōjin Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: Scurry
results.overview: Two strangers find themselves trapped underground when the city is attacked by a monstrous threat. Badly injured with limited resources they must navigate a treacherous, narrowing tunnel in hopes of finding an exit.

results.title: Доставщик
results.overview: The last order of the outgoing year goes to a courier with disabilities (cerebral palsy), who will have to make the delivery before the chimes to receive the coveted bonus. But on the way to the goal, he is constantly distracted by seemingly ordinary passers-by with their own problems.

results.title: Carl-Einar Häckner i för långt borta land
results.original_title: Carl-Einar Häckner i för långt borta land
results.overview: A warm declaration of love for life with Carl-Einar Häckner. The stage show 'In a land far away' promises 'timeless magic, songs and spontaneous humour, a certain amount of anxiety but also desire, a lot of desire'. Everyone is welcome to Häckner's universe as they are. The stage is filled with hilarity, raw emotions and magic. After touring to sold-out houses around Sweden, the show is shown here in a recording from Aftonstjärnan in Gothenburg.
